revenue_scope: Product line as printed, no regional sub-rows
moa: NMDA receptor antagonist and sigma-1 receptor agonist (dextromethorphan) combined with a CYP2D6 inhibitor (quinidine) that raises dextromethorphan exposure

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 021879 ... Nuedexta (dextromethorphan hydrobromide and quinidine sulfate) Capsules ... for the treatment of pseudobulbar affect (PBA) ... It is approved, effective on the date of this letter (electronic signature dated 10/29/2010)

series_start_reason: Series starts at 2011Q2. Before Otsuka acquired Avanir Pharmaceuticals (January 2015) Avanir reported NUEDEXTA net product sales itself, in USD, in fiscal quarters that end on calendar quarter-ends (its fiscal year ends 30 September); NUEDEXTA was commercially launched in February 2011, so launch_quarter is 2011Q1. Avanir's earnings releases state net NUEDEXTA revenue in the narrative for every quarter from the first: the quarter ended 31 March 2011 as '$462,000' (8-K exhibit 99.1 filed 2011-05-09), the quarter ended 30 June 2011 as '$1.9 million' (filed 2011-08-08) and the quarter ended 30 September 2011 as '$3.7 million' (filed 2011-12-12). The last two are rows. The first is printed in whole dollars only, in the narrative and in the income statement (net product sales 462,014); the manifest format carries a printed figure in thousands, millions or billions and has no unit for whole dollars, so 2011Q1 is not a row and the series starts at the first quarter printed in a supported unit. Avanir's last quarter is the one ended 30 September 2014 (2014Q3); 2014Q4 is printed by neither owner (see unreported_quarters). Otsuka's series, in yen, starts with 2015Q1: the first FACT BOOK with a NUEDEXTA sales line is the 4Q 2015 edition (2016-02-12), and the 1Q 2016 edition (2016-05-13) prints 1Q 2015 (3.7) as a prior-year column; the FACT BOOKs dated 2015-02-13 to 2015-11-13 name Avanir's products only in their pipeline tables (the 2015-02-13 edition lists them as 'Events after December 31, 2014'). Quarters before 2018Q2 of Otsuka's series are derived by subtraction from year-to-date columns, because FACT BOOKs before the 2Q 2019 edition print year-to-date columns only. The FDA approval is dated 2010-10-29.
notes: Otsuka prints NUEDEXTA as a single line ('Agent for pseudobulbar affect (PBA) / NUEDEXTA') in the Pharmaceutical business table with no regional sub-rows, so the geography is not shown by the table; no table read here states the geography. Values are in billions of yen with one decimal; the recorded value is that figure times 1,000 (millions of yen). The line is printed in the quarterly-data table of every FACT BOOK from 2019-08-08 on; the text layers of the editions dated 2019-08-08, 2019-11-12, 2020-02-14, 2020-05-28 and 2020-08-07 split most of its figures with spaces (for example '6 .1'), while those dated 2020-11-13 and later read cleanly. The label printed on the figure line in the FACT BOOK dated 2026-07-31 is 'Otsuka Pharmaceutical' (the brand is named on the next line). Full-year check: for the years 2020 to 2022 (where the full-year figure is printed in the FACT BOOK for the fourth quarter) the four quarterly figures sum to the printed full year exactly. Where a quarter's own edition cannot be read, the row cites the first edition that prints the quarter legibly, or a legible first-half, nine-month or full-year column from which the quarter is derived; rows built on text with split digits quote the line as extracted and say so. Full-year check for the added years: 2015 3.7 + 4.7 + 5.3 + 5.5 = 19.2; 2016 5.6 + 5.5 + 6.3 + 6.2 = 23.6; 2017 6.2 + 7.2 + 6.2 + 6.0 = 25.6; 2018 5.4 + 6.1 + 6.5 + 7.5 = 25.5, each equal to the printed full year; 2019 6.4 + 6.1 + 6.0 + 8.0 = 26.5 against a printed 26.4 (rounding of one-decimal figures). Avanir's rows (2011Q4-2014Q3) are Avanir's USD net product sales of NUEDEXTA, which it sold only in the United States; the Otsuka line from 2015Q1 does not state its geography. Avanir's income statement label is 'Net product sales' (gross product sales less discounts and allowances); the recorded figure is the net amount that the earnings release states in USD millions as 'net NUEDEXTA sales/revenue' (the 10-K for fiscal 2014 for the last quarter, in thousands). Geography remains unstated by the table. Row labels: in the FACT BOOK layout the brand name is printed on the line below the figures (or, in some editions, the figures and brand share a line whose characters the text layer interleaves), so each row's row_label is the printed class heading on the figure line, the only label the figures can be matched under; a brand-named label was tried on every existing row and matched none of them. Avanir's 2011Q1 net NUEDEXTA revenue of $462,000 (net product sales 462,014 dollars) is printed in the 2011-05-09 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/858803/000095012311047370/a59466exv99w1.htm) but not in a unit the manifest format supports, so it is not a row; the row_label for the 2011Q2 and 2011Q3 rows is the same 'NUEDEXTA' as the later Avanir rows.
search_log: otsuka.com/en/ir/library/materials.html builds its document list in the browser from a JSON feed (https://ssl4.eir-parts.net/Custom/public/v5parts/4578/en/20210609/app/conf/common_conf.js names it as http://v4.eir-parts.net/V4Public/eir/4578/en/announcement/announcement_4.js, fetched over https); that feed lists 1,070 items; the 63 items titled 'FACT BOOK' (2011-02-14 to 2026-07-31, ir_material_for_fiscal_ym3) were all downloaded and read with pdfplumber (the verifier's extractor) and pdftotext

the seven FACT BOOKs dated 2011-05-12 to 2012-11-13 yield no text from pdftotext (no text layer) and those dated 2013-02 to 2019-05 print year-to-date columns (3 months, 1H, 9 months, full year) with no quarterly table; the first FACT BOOK with a 'Pharmaceutical business <Reference> Quarterly Data' table is the one dated 2019-08-08 (2Q 2019). FACT BOOKs dated 2018-08, 2018-11 and 2025-07 have unmapped-glyph text layers for the figures; 2019-05 and 2022-02 split the digits of many figures with spaces

Quarterly values come from the quarterly-data table of each FACT BOOK: the last column is the FACT BOOK's own quarter and earlier columns are the prior-year and year-to-date quarters; where a quarter's own FACT BOOK was unreadable or lacked the line, the first later FACT BOOK that prints the quarter in a readable table is cited and the row's context says why

Otsuka's quarterly earnings release (Kessan Tanshin, TDnet) and the Financial Results Presentation were not used: the Tanshin prints year-to-date product sales in prose (for example the FY2025 one at https://fs2.magicalir.net/tdnet/2026/4578/20260213559778.pdf) and the FACT BOOK carries the single-quarter table
searched all 63 FACT BOOKs (pdftotext) for the brand name; the 'Sales of Major Products' tables name the brand from the 2013 editions on for Abilify Maintena and later for the others
FACT BOOK for 2Q 2026 (dated 2026-07-31) is the latest published at the time of the search; the Q3 2026 results are not yet released

FACT BOOKs dated 2015-02-13 to 2018-05-11 re-read with pdfplumber (the verifier's extractor) and pdftotext -layout: they print year-to-date columns (3 months, 1H, 9 months, full year), so single quarters before 2018Q2 are derived (year_to_date_less_reported_quarters, annual_less_reported_first_nine_months) from the editions whose lines carry the inputs; 1Q figures are printed as three-month columns in their own editions or as prior-year columns of the next year's 1Q edition; every derived row quotes the line it uses and states the other input and its edition.

FACT BOOKs dated 2019-02-13 to 2020-08-07 read with pdfplumber: the NUEDEXTA lines of 2019-02-13, 2019-05-14 (partly), 2019-08-08, 2019-11-12, 2020-02-14, 2020-05-28 and 2020-08-07 split the digits of most figures with spaces, so 2018Q2 and 2018Q4 are derived from the first-half and full-year/nine-month columns of 2019-08-08 and 2019-11-12 (quoted as extracted), 2018Q3 is read from the one legible figure of the 2019-11-12 line, 2019Q1 from the one legible three-month figure of the 2019-05-14 line, and 2019Q2 to 2019Q4 from the legible prior-year columns of the 2020-11-13 edition; 2018-08-08 and 2018-11-14 have unmapped-glyph text layers.

FACT BOOK editions dated 2020-11-13 and 2021-02-12 print the NUEDEXTA line (the earlier note that these editions omit it was wrong): 2020Q3 and 2020Q4 are now read from their own editions and 2020Q1 and 2020Q2 from the 2020-11-13 table.
FACT BOOK dated 2017-05-12 (1Q 2017): pdfplumber text interleaves the characters of the row label, so 1Q 2017 (6.2) is cited from the prior-year column of the 1Q 2018 FACT BOOK (2018-05-11).

Otsuka 'Financial Results' presentations (ir_material_for_fiscal_ym2, dated 2018-05-11, 2018-08-08, 2018-11-14, 2019-02-13, 2019-05-14, 2019-08-08, 2019-11-12, 2020-02-14) downloaded and searched with pdftotext: no per-product quarterly sales table for these products (NUEDEXTA is named only in narrative about the Avanir acquisition and a legal settlement in the 2018-05-11 and 2019-02-13 decks).

Extension before 2015Q1: Avanir Pharmaceuticals (CIK 0000858803) filings listed with data.sec.gov submissions; fetched every Form 10-Q, Form 10-K and every 8-K earnings-release exhibit (item 2.02) from 2011-02 to 2014-08 and the Form 10-K filed 2014-12-10. Income-statement line 'Net product sales' in whole dollars: quarter ended 31 Mar 2011 462,014; 30 Jun 2011 1,932,235; 30 Sep 2011 3,695,057; 31 Dec 2011 5,488,763; 31 Mar 2012 9,141,873; 30 Jun 2012 10,050,573; 30 Sep 2012 12,393,358 (prior-year column of the 2013-12-10 release); 31 Dec 2012 14,879,262; 31 Mar 2013 16,535,059; 30 Jun 2013 19,044,288; 30 Sep 2013 20,233,418; 31 Dec 2013 23,299,027; 31 Mar 2014 24,379,159; 30 Jun 2014 26,540,131; the Form 10-K for fiscal 2014 prints the quarter ended 30 Sep 2014 as 31,223 thousand. The rows use the USD-million narrative of each release (the dollar figures round to them) because whole dollars cannot be recorded as printed in the manifest units.
No Avanir filing covers the quarter ended 31 December 2014 (last periodic report: Form 10-K filed 2014-12-10; Form 15-12B filed 2015-01-15); Otsuka's FACT BOOK of 2015-02-13 does not include Avanir.

Correction of the earlier statement that the 2011 quarters appear only in whole dollars and that releases state millions only from December 2011: re-read the Avanir 8-K exhibits 99.1 in work/avanir. 2011-05-09 (quarter ended 31 March 2011): 'NUEDEXTA gross and net revenue of $505,000 and $462,000 respectively'; 2011-08-08 (quarter ended 30 June 2011): 'NUEDEXTA gross and net revenue of $2.2 million and $1.9 million respectively'; 2011-12-12 (quarter ended 30 September 2011): 'NUEDEXTA gross and net revenue of $4.3 million and $3.7 million respectively'. The latter two are narrative figures in millions of the same kind as the 2011Q4 row and were added as 2011Q2 and 2011Q3; the first is in dollars (see series_start_reason).

launch_evidence.quote: the product sales of NUEDEXTA which we began promoting commercially in February 2011

unreported_quarters.2014Q4: Ownership change Avanir Pharmaceuticals to Otsuka; neither owner published a Nuedexta figure for the quarter. Avanir's last periodic report is the Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended 30 September 2014 (filed 2014-12-10), which prints its fiscal fourth quarter ended 30 September 2014 (calendar 2014Q3); Otsuka's tender offer for Avanir completed in January 2015 (Avanir Form 15-12B filed 2015-01-15), no Avanir report covers the quarter ended 31 December 2014, and Otsuka's FACT BOOKs for the period to 31 December 2014 list Avanir only as an event after 31 December 2014. Otsuka's series starts with 2015Q1.

reviewed_anomalies.2012Q1: Avanir's reported net product sales for the quarter ended 31 March 2012 (9.1) include a one-time 1.7 recognised on a change in accounting estimate for returns; the same release prints net NUEDEXTA sales of 7.4 without it. Kept as the reported line, the line every other quarter uses.
reviewed_anomalies.2012Q3: Derived in thousands from the annual figure (37,075) and the nine months in dollars (24,681,209), so it carries the rounding of the annual thousands figure; the release for the quarter (8-K 2012-11-30) prints only gross NUEDEXTA revenue (15.4).
reviewed_anomalies.2015Q1: Issuer and currency step: the quarters to 2014Q3 are Avanir's net product sales of NUEDEXTA in USD millions; from 2015Q1 they are Otsuka's NUEDEXTA line in millions of yen (FACT BOOK, billions of yen times 1,000). The first Otsuka quarter (3,700 million yen) is of the same order as the 31.2 USD million of Avanir's last quarter, as the same product line in the same market would be; 2014Q4 between them is unreported.
